samples.summary: Scope creep beyond issue #728: a full CSS-color normalizer + OOXML export policy rides along with a canvas-paint bugfix
samples.evidence: Issue #728's acceptance criterion is purely about painting: "Type text, select it, reset the text color → the text is uncolored (default ink), not the selection color." The minimal fix is the toolbar `undefined` change plus `resolveStoredColor` at the paint sinks. The diff additionally introduces `toRgbHexColor` with `#RGB` expansion, `#RRGGBBAA` alpha stripping, `rgb()/rgba()` parsing, channel clamping and a new "fully transparent → drop the attribute" policy, and rewires DOCX run props, DOCX table-cell fills and four PPTX color children (`solidFill`, `highlight`, `uFill`, `buClr`) to it — new export behavior for values that have nothing to do with the `''` reset (e.g. `rgb(255,0,0)` previously emitted verbatim, `rgba(0,0,0,0.0)` previously emitted opaque). Defensible hardening, but it is a separate concern from the reported bug and enlarges the blast radius of a paint fix into two exporters.

samples.summary: New OOXML export color policy is not recorded in any design doc (CONTRIBUTING requires updating the canonical subsystem doc for non-trivial changes)
samples.evidence: The diff changes documented export mappings — `docs-docx-import-export.md:299-312` still states the plain `<w:color w:val>` / `<w:shd w:fill>` ↔ `style.color`/`backgroundColor` correspondence, and `slides-pptx-export.md:148-151` still documents `{kind:'srgb'} → <a:srgbClr val="RRGGBB">` unconditionally, with no mention of the new rules introduced here (non-hex values drop the attribute/child, fully transparent colors drop, partial alpha renders opaque, `''` means unset). No `docs/design/**` file is touched by the diff; the only written record is the task plan `docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md`, which CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16,56-58 treats as the plan, not the design record. If reviewers consider this a bugfix only, no doc is owed; if the new shared model-level normalizer and export drop-policy count as a data-model/export contract change, the canonical docs should be updated rather than left stale.

samples.summary: The PDF export sink keeps its own ad-hoc hex parser and is not routed through the new shared normalizer, so "one shared normalizer backs every export sink" is only partly true
samples.evidence: `styleColor()` still does `defaultColorResolver(hex)` then `/^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i`, falling back to **black** for anything else, and it is the color path for `pdf-painter.ts:389,635,706,759` and `pdf-table-painter.ts:178`. The same untrusted shapes the diff's rationale cites (HTML-paste `rgb(255, 0, 0)`, `#abc`, `#RRGGBBAA`) therefore export as black in PDF while now exporting correctly in DOCX/PPTX — an inconsistency the change's own stated design goal ("every export sink that writes a color … needs this", model/color.ts:69) argues against. Either route `styleColor` through `toRgbHexColor` or narrow the doc comment's claim.

samples.summary: `toDocxHexColor` is a zero-logic alias of `toRgbHexColor`, plus a duplicate test suite for it
samples.evidence: `export function toDocxHexColor(color) { return toRgbHexColor(color); }` adds an exported indirection with no behavior, and `test/export/docx-style-map.test.ts` re-tests the same cases already covered by `test/model/color.test.ts`'s `toRgbHexColor` block. Importing `toRgbHexColor` directly in `docx-style-map.ts`/`docx-exporter.ts` would remove a public export and a redundant suite; the DOCX-facing naming rationale can live in a comment.

samples.summary: Generic CSS→hex normalization lands in @wafflebase/docs rather than the shared core, alongside two pre-existing near-duplicates
samples.evidence: The repo already holds color parsing in `packages/core/src/tokens/contrast.ts:3-53` (`hexToRgb`/`parseColor`) and `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/grids.ts:132` (`cssColorToHex`, an `rgb()`→hex converter with sheets-specific white-skipping). `toRgbHexColor` is a third implementation of the same CSS→hex concern, now exported from both docs entries (`index.ts`, `node.ts`) purely so slides' PPTX exporter can reach it. Given the repo convention that cross-package helpers live in `@wafflebase/core`, `core/tokens` looks like the more natural home; docs is defensible only because slides already depends on it.

verdict.reason: Searched the entire docs/ tree (not just the two files the reviewer checked) for the new export color policy — greps for toRgbHexColor/toDocxHexColor/resolveStoredColor/ST_HexColor/storedColorToThemeColor, w:color|w:shd|srgbClr, transparent|alpha, schema-invalid|injection, StoredColor|backgroundColor — and every hit is in packages/** source/tests, .agent-review/**, or the task plan docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-{todo,lessons}.md. No docs/design/** file records the new rules. The policy is a real model-level export contract (packages/docs/src/model/color.ts:45-116 adds resolveStoredColor ('' = unset) and toRgbHexColor: non-hex drops, fully transparent drops, partial alpha renders opaque), shared by both OOXML sinks (packages/docs/src/export/docx-style-map.ts, packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts). The canonical docs are now stale: docs/design/docs/docs-docx-import-export.md:422-425 (§3.3) asserts export is simply "the inverse of the tables in Section 2.3", which no longer holds for colors, and docs/design/slides/slides-pptx-export.md:148-152 still documents {kind:'srgb'} → <a:srgbClr val="RRGGBB"> unconditionally. CONTRIBUTING.md:55-59 requires updating the existing subsystem design doc; CONTRIBUTING.md:60-63 designates docs/tasks/ as the execution plan, not the design record. Note one inaccuracy in the reviewer's evidence that does not change the outcome: docs-docx-import-export.md:289-312 is the import mapping table, not an export table — the stale export statement is §3.3 instead. Residual doubt is only the lens judgement the finding itself raises (if treated as a pure bug fix no doc is owed), which is not a refutation ground.
